name: cad-reverse-engineer
description: Reverse-engineer CAD from papers, patents and datasheets: a parametric build123d model where every stated number is quoted from a hashed source and checked on the built geometry, and what they leave open is listed beside the question that would settle it.

interface.longDescription: Rebuild a part, gripper or mechanism from a paper, patent, supplement or datasheet as a parametric build123d model, STEP and MuJoCo, where every number the sources state is a verbatim quote and every stated value is checked against the built geometry. The cadrev CLI runs locally and needs uv; its first run downloads build123d, OCC and MuJoCo from PyPI, so allow network access in ~/.codex/config.toml: network_access = true under [sandbox_workspace_write].
defaultPrompt: Reverse-engineer the gripper in this paper as CAD
